Tests.Title: Verify the consumed Kafka message count is equal to the amount of data lines in the CSV וידוא שכמות ההודעות הנכנסות זהה לכמות שורות הנתונים בקובץ
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>create a file path for the csv</p></div></div> <div><p>path created</p></div> <div><div><p>count the data lines in the csv</p></div></div> <div><p>lines counted</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the file path to the relevant kafka topic</p></div></div> <div><p>path produced to kafka</p></div> <div><div><p>consume the messages from the relevant kafka topic</p></div></div> <div><p>messages consumed</p></div> <div><p>verify the amount of messages from step 4 is equal to the lines counted in step 2</p></div> <p>the amounts are the same</p>

Tests.Title: Verify the message in the consumed Kafka topic contains all the CSV headers וידוא שההודעה כוללת את כל הכותרות של הקובץ

Tests.Title: Verify the CSV data appears as expected in the Kafka consumed message וידוא שהנתונים של הקובץ מופיעים כמו שצריך בהודעה
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>create a file path for the csv</p></div></div> <div><p>path created</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the file path to the relevant kafka topic</p></div></div> <div><p>path produced to kafka</p></div> <div><div><p>consume the message from the relevant kafka topic</p></div></div> <div><p>message consumed</p></div> <div><p>verify in the consumed message that the data appears as in the csv and under the relevant headers</p></div> <p>as expected</p>

Tests.Title: A malformed CSV file isn't entered into Kafka consume topic קובץ תקול לא מועבר לטופיק צריכה של קפקא
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>have a malformed csv file</p></div></div> <div><p>file ready</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the file to the relevant kafka topic </p></div></div> <div><p>file produced to kafka</p></div> <div><p>verify there's no message related to the csv in the relevant other kafka topic (consume)</p></div> <p>as expected</p>

Tests.Title: Malformed CSV data line enters to the rejects Kafka topic שורה לא תקינה בקובץ נכנסת לטופיק שגויים
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>have a csv file with multiple data lines, when 1 line has blank cell/s</p></div></div> <div><p>csv file ready</p></div> <div><div><p>count the amount of valid lines in the csv</p></div></div> <div><p>lines counted</p></div> <div><div><p>set the relevant boolean in mongo to continue produce lines from the csv when there's a malformed line</p></div></div> <div><p>boolean set</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the csv to the relevant kafka topic</p></div></div> <div><p>csv produced to kafka</p></div> <div><div><p>verify that the relevant kafka consume topic has as many messages as the valid csv lines you counted in step 2</p></div></div> <div><p>as expected</p></div> <div><p>verify the rejects topic has 1 message for the malformed line</p></div> <p>as expected</p>

Tests.Title: Kafka consume topic stops receiving messages when the CSV has a malformed line קפקא מפסיקה לייצר הודעות כשאחת השורות בקובץ לא תקינה
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>have a csv file with multiple data lines, when 1 line has blank cell/s</p></div></div> <div><p>csv file ready</p></div> <div><div><p>count the amount of valid lines before the malformed line</p></div></div> <div><p>lines counted</p></div> <div><div><p>set the relevant boolean in mongo to stop produce lines from the csv when there's a malformed line</p></div></div> <div><p>boolean set</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the csv to the relevant kafka topic</p></div></div> <div><p>csv produced to kafka</p></div> <div><div><p>verify that the relevant kafka consume topic has as many messages as the valid csv lines you counted in step 2</p></div></div> <div><p>as expected</p></div> <div><p>verify the rejects topic has 1 message for the malformed line</p></div> <p>as expected</p>

Tests.Title: Producement of a non-existant file path won't get to the consume topic קובץ שלא קיים בתיקייה לא יגיע לטופיק האחרון
Tests.Steps: <div><p>set a file path to the shared files folder, and set the filename to a name of a non-existant file</p></div> <div><p>file path set</p></div> <div><div><p>count the messages amount in the consume topic</p></div></div> <div><p>messages counted</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the non-existant file path to the relevant topic</p></div></div> <div><p>file path produced</p></div> <div><div><p>repeat step 2</p></div></div> <p>messages counted again</p> <div><p>verify the amounts in steps 2 &amp; 4 are equal</p></div> <p>the amounts are equal</p>

Tests.Title: Producement of a CSV path without data lines won't get to the consume topic קובץ ללא דאטה לא יגיע לטופיק האחרון
Tests.Steps: <div><p>have a csv without data lines in the shared folder</p></div> <div><p>file ready</p></div> <div><div><p>count the messages amount in the consume topic</p></div></div> <div><p>messages counted</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the csv path to the relevant topic</p></div></div> <div><p>file path produced</p></div> <div><div><p>repeat step 2</p></div></div> <div><p>messages counted again</p></div> <div><p>verify the amounts in steps 2 &amp; 4 are equal</p></div> <p>the amounts are equal</p>

Tests.Title: E2E for CSV בדיקת קצה לקצה לקובץ
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>have a csv file with valid data lines</p></div></div> <div><p>file set</p></div> <div><div><p>count the amount of data lines in the file</p></div></div> <div><p>lines counted</p></div> <div><div><p>count the amount of messages in the consume topic</p></div></div> <div><p>messages amount counted</p></div> <div><div><p>produce the csv file path to the relevant topic</p></div></div> <div><p>file path produced</p></div> <div><div><p>repeat step 2, and verify the amount of messages is equal to the amount from step 2 + the amount from step 3</p></div></div> <div><p>as expected</p></div> <div><p>verify that the jsons from the consumed messages are in the expected format and have valid data</p></div> <p>as expected</p>

Tests.Title: CSV load test בדיקת עומסים
Tests.Steps: <div><div><p>have a valid csv file</p></div></div> <div><p>file set</p></div> <div><div><p>count the data lines from the file</p></div></div> <div><p>lines counted</p></div> <div><div><p>count the amount of messages in the consume topic</p></div></div> <div><p>messages counted</p></div> <div><p>produce the file path to the relevant topic 1000 times, with 0.5 sec break between each path</p></div> <p>file paths produced</p> <div><p>repeat step 3 and verify the new amount is equal to the old amount, plus 1000 times the amount from step 2.<br/>for example, the csv has 5 data lines, the old message count is 0, so the new count should be 5000 (0+5*1000)</p></div> <p>as expected</p>
